notes: Sourced directly from the manufacturer's official Owner's Manual (v2.31, May 2011), Chapter 2 "I/O's Description and Cable Requirements" and rear/front panel diagrams — this is the most authoritative available spec source; the manufacturer's product page for this now-discontinued/legacy item (brainstormtime.com/support/legacy/) does not host a separate detailed spec sheet, so the manual was used directly. No grade field applies to any port: the DCD-8's connectors are all audio/word-clock/video-reference/DC-power types, none of which fall on the SDI/HDMI/DisplayPort/USB/Ethernet bandwidth scales the schema grades. Two optional expansion cards exist but are not counted as standard I/O since they require separate purchase/installation: the VSG-4 Video Sync Generator (adds HD/SD video sync outputs) and the CX-4 Word Clock Expansion card (adds 4 more BNC word-clock outputs, pairs 9&10 and 11&12). The FireWire (IEEE 1394, 6-pin) port has no exact match in the allowed connector list; usb-b was chosen as the closest physical analog and grade was omitted since FireQire 400's 400Mbit/s spec doesn't map to the given usb-x grade scale. The chassis DC power input is a proprietary multi-pin connector fed from an external universal AC-DC brick (100-240VAC, 12VDC@25W out); dc-barrel was used as the closest listed connector id. Rear-panel AES/EBU XLR I/O and Word Clock BNC I/O are unlabeled with individual numbers on the panel itself but are referred to as AES1/AES2 and WC1/WC2 etc. throughout the front-panel menu system, which was used for naming. The unit also has a 3rd Word Clock input and 3rd (unbalanced AES3id) AES/EBU input on the front panel, in addition to the 2 of each on the rear.

ports.name: Power In
ports.note: Powered by an external universal 100-240VAC/50-60Hz supply (12VDC @ 25W) via a proprietary multi-pin DIN-style DC connector on the chassis; dc-barrel is the closest listed connector type. The external brick itself has an IEC power inlet for its AC cord.

ports.name: FireWire (1394)
ports.note: IEEE 1394 FireWire 400, 6-pin connector; not in the provided connector list, usb-b chosen as closest physical analog. Used for 8-channel bidirectional digital audio I/O and firmware updates.

ports.name: Video Ref In
ports.note: Accepts NTSC/PAL/HD analog video reference; unterminated.

ports.name: Video Ref Loop
ports.note: Loop-through of Video Ref In; must be 75-ohm terminated if the DCD-8 is last in chain.

ports.name: AES/EBU In 3 (front panel)
ports.note: Unbalanced AES3id input on front-panel BNC; shares circuitry with the rear Optical I/O and is disconnected when Optical I/O is set to S/PDIF Optical mode.
